notes.title: The Ape Tales: An Epic Adventure Game is NOW AVAILABLE
notes.content:
[h3]The Adventure is here![/h3]

Welcome to The Ape Tales: An Epic Adventure Game! The big release day came and we would like to thank you all! We cannot wait to see your reactions on the social media. We hope the epic adventure will grow with you and stay in your mind for a long time. ːsteamthisː

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44869646/e0458ed606b0c74a4541cb2a76c6e06d093e50a9.png[/img]

Remember that after collecting all hidden collectables you will be able to reveal more! Just go to the greenhouse and check your collection of plants. You can collect them by making quests, solving puzzles and completing the final level.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44869646/3a707ed9c405b01fcae8bcfedfa35aef41ce4391.png[/img]

We hope to see your fantastic images from the game on social media or on our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2608600]community page of The Ape Tales: An Epic Adventure[/url]. ːsteamthumbsupː

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44869646/5bfa75eba53fe724945643e3a2aa24d81d72eaa9.png[/img]

If you still haven't jumped into our game, you can check our game features below. ːsteamhappyː

[h2]Game features:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Over 12+ maps, each with different enemies
[*] Meet the dwellers and make quests to unlock the epilogue
[*] Every map means a new challenging boss to encounter
[*] Collect tokens and buy new weapons, abilities and skins
[*] Travel from prehistoric to the future world
[*] and much... much more!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44869646/1594b22a8c2065cece341903c29f07795ebd9198.png[/img]

Stay tuned for more information in the future! See you!

[i]Roker Games Studio[/i]

notes.title: Launch day is right around the corner!
notes.content:
[h2]Welcome to The Ape Tales: An Epic Adventure Game!
[/h2]

Jump into the adventure on [b]16.12.2024[/b] and start your journey through many worlds with The Ape Tales: An Epic Adventure Game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44869646/82b88924da51efaaae0332c5e1a96ea407a642db.png[/img]


The game has changed over the years, and finally, we created an end-shaped experience that we hope will come to your hearts through the epic adventures that are waiting on you. The nostalgic and modern feeling of the game was our main duty.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44869646/b39672c3d8c55ecf92e9a618f709471edab49c7e.png[/img]


In the game, you will encounter more than 40 enemies that will try to stop you! Each map in The Ape Tales provides a new experience because each of them contains new enemies and challenges. Do you defeat them all? Will you save the world from evil?


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44869646/57440fe93cb80a56bd10418c4df3f294535e9bdd.png[/img]


We worked hard to provide the best product on the launch day, and we hope that you will love it! I assure you that it is not the end because we will be still updating the game, so stay tuned!

[i]Roker Games Studio[/i]
